research_decision: Build native, point-in-time option exposure scenarios with explicit pricing, OI vintage, scope and root finding; dealer inventory remains unobserved.

bindings.native_products: NDX, NDXP, SPX, SPXW, QQQ, SPY separately; no price-coordinate pooling
bindings.snapshots: every 5 minutes 09:35–15:55, latest available inputs only
bindings.default_expiry: same-day expiration at true settlement timestamp
bindings.European_pricing: E10 parity-forward Black; native cash branch only if acquired
bindings.American_ETF_pricing: E10 CRR and declared dividend approximation
bindings.walls: same-right strike gamma maxima; keep OI-only walls separate
bindings.consumer: F15 BIG, F16 optional gate; no direct option orders
bindings.quote_spread_sensitivity: 0.15,0.30,0.50; diagnostic only, never selected for better PnL
bindings.option_flow_pressure: E10 previous complete 5 minute signed delta-notional transaction pressure; optional output with 80% quantity/sign/Greek coverage, never dealer-position inference

scenario.meaning: explicit scenarios, not observed dealer ownership

max_relative_spread.meaning: Fixed baseline quality cap; 0.15 and 0.50 are separately reported coverage sensitivities, excluded from alpha selection.

strike_scope.meaning: subsets of actually acquired scope; coverage ratio denominator matches selected scope

gamma_stress_threshold.meaning: E10 stress-boundary root, separately named from zero-gamma flip; test subsequent realized volatility rather than asserting a volatility switch

algorithm: Create contract metadata and actual OI publication vintages, expiry instants, multipliers and exercise styles. As-of join each quote/spot/rate; known_at is maximum availability, not a request-date assumption.

Apply D06 quality and declared scope. Build European index forward from synchronized put-call pairs or native acquired cash; ETF spot is its own completed minute close. No NQ-to-NDX or ES-to-SPX level copy.

Solve IV and Greeks under E10 with convergence/no-arbitrage checks, then aggregate each sign scenario by native product and expiry cohort. Export calls, puts, net/gross and missing OI coverage separately.

Reprice aggregate gamma over E10 grid, find genuine sign-change roots, select nearest root and export all roots. Compute same-right gamma/OI walls and native distance features. Missing flip is no_flip, not zero gamma.

Fit native level-response/path distributions and test fixed NQ consumer gates only with fully available snapshots. A snapshot changes only when its inputs change; wall updates have their own expiry, not session-high first-visit semantics.

Compute E10 gamma-stress roots at the selected threshold and optional signed option-flow pressure. Keep those objects separate from flip/walls and evaluate later realized-volatility/consumer responses; missing trade-quote pressure does not suppress a valid gamma snapshot.
controls: unsigned gross exposure vs signed scenarios
acceptance_cases: A zero-to-positive cumulative sequence is not a negative/positive flip.
NDXP OI published 06:30 cannot be used 00:00 that day.
Daily full-chain OI plus scoped minute quotes does not imply full intraday-chain coverage.
Equal NDX and NQ numeric prices do not authorize treating them as the same underlying.
unavailable_policy: E00 typed states; any required unavailable input prevents a signal; complete eligible windows with no event emit no_event; interrupted outcomes are censored
shared_acceptance: Prefix replay through available_at exactly reproduces all features and selected IDs.
Future price, volume, profile and calendar revisions cannot change an earlier decision.
Both external high and low obey independent first-visit retirement; areas retain their separate lifecycle.
Every filled trade is linked to a real signal, submitted order and later observable fill; no full-session extrema before entry.
title: Native options, gamma scenario and level-conditioned regime

research_decision: Use prior-known VIX bands and explicitly scaled return-volatility forecasts, then test their usefulness instead of interpreting membership as performance.

bindings.raw_scale: anchor*VIX/(100*sqrt(252)), a return-volatility point scale, not full high-low width
bindings.consumer: J01/A01/F18 context only; no same-day VIX close feature

volatility_index.meaning: VXN variant requires its actual D08 history; missing is unavailable

calibration.meaning: raw index return-volatility scale or type7 q68 of prior normalized absolute return ratios, as defined in the algorithm

history_sessions.meaning: only used by calibration/conditional probability history

algorithm: Find last published volatility-index observation available before decision, preserving date and publication lag through holidays.
Assign exact nonoverlapping VIX bands for VIX; for VXN keep the same numeric boundaries as an explicitly different research categorization and export raw value.

Compute raw point scale. For calibrated variant take type7 q68 of prior N absolute NQ close-to-close return divided by corresponding prior-known index/(100sqrt252), then multiply current raw scale by that ratio. Samples crossing an un adjusted contract roll are excluded.

Measure future absolute close return and full high-low range as distinct labels, calibrate coverage/pinball loss, and test fixed consumers versus no-volatility context. Do not draw full-width bands without naming the scale convention.
acceptance_cases: Today eventual VIX close cannot gate today 09:30.

research_decision: Measure thesis survival from actual creation to the first qualified invalidation cause, preserving the delay between a breach and its confirmation.

bindings.thesis_source: consumer parent decision supplies side and broad frozen balance/area; no automatic noon thesis
bindings.structural_death: long: close below lower edge then outside hold; short above upper edge; neutral either
bindings.profile_death: developing RTH VA overlap fraction below threshold in3 consecutive complete-minute snapshots, only after 10:00
bindings.news_death: actual scheduled CPI, NFP, FOMC, ISM release time after thesis start when selected
bindings.objective_completion: target first visit, separate from death
bindings.consumer: J24/S07 diagnostics or explicitly timed thesis-exit variant

cause_set.meaning: required inputs depend on selected causes

overlap_cutoff.meaning: intersection length/min(developing VA width, thesis width), both positive

algorithm: At actual parent creation freeze thesis ID, side, band, objectives and initial availability. A new thesis needs a new ID; do not redraw the old band.
Track structural breach start and full-hold confirmation independently. First exact revisit retires any external objective, but does not automatically kill structural thesis.

For enabled profile cause compute as-of E03 VA overlap and its three-snapshot confirmation. For enabled news cause use verified actual release time and calendar coverage; unknown required cause history makes complete survival unknown.

End at earliest qualified confirmation/release, retaining tied causes. Lifetime is end-start; alive-at-noon is right-censored at noon, not presumed alive until 16:00. Paired thesis-exit tests use identical parent entries.
controls: fixed parent exit for any trade consumer
acceptance_cases: Breach 10:00 with 30subsequent held closes is known 10:30, not 10:00.
Objective reached 10:15 and structural death 11:00 are different events.
No observations after 12:00 imply censoring, not survival to 16:00.

research_decision: Rebuild native NQ/ES/YM comparison objects and first-take/first-fill state; use each market’s own levels and units.

bindings.markets: NQ, ES, YM baseline; optional RTY replaces YM
bindings.primary_event: NQ first fresh prior RTH H/L take with at least one covered sister untaken at same event time
bindings.sister_staleness: last trade<=5 seconds old and complete intervening feed coverage
bindings.directional_outcome: NQ high first mismatch -> later short response; low first -> long response, a research hypothesis

third_market.meaning: actual own data, no ratio mapping

object_type.meaning: three separate event definitions in algorithm

response_fraction.meaning: post-event15 minute response, no cross-market price subtraction

sister_agreement_seconds.meaning: diagnostic lag window after first event; not available at first take

algorithm: Build corresponding prior RTH high/low, VP70 and TPO ledgers per market with real calendar and first-visit history. Reject missing maps/coverage; ES BBO is not needed for price-based sister events.

For prior_extreme, observe exact first takes and compare persistent taken/not_taken states asof NQ event. Co-timed events without cross-market ordering are co-first/ambiguous, not fabricated leaders. Later sister agreement is a new timestamped state.

For prior_VA_reaction, compare same-side E02 reactions at each own prior VA edge using own4 tick threshold. For TPO_first_fill, match runs by(origin trading date, singleton period letter, ordinal from low); require equal run counts for that letter across selected markets, then compare each own first contact/full repair times. No price-level mapping is used.

After eligible event measure each sister and NQ response in its own width/ticks over15 minutes; a sister-first full repair can invalidate the paired target at that time. Test causal first-event features in consumers, never eventual whole AM agreement.
controls: native prior H/L vs VA vs TPO event types
acceptance_cases: NQ30000 is compared to its own NQ high, never ES6000.
A sister high taken overnight stays taken after price returns below it.
A TPO run only partially filled has not reached full repair.
Missing sister data means unknown, not divergence.
